text:
Which statements about homologous series are correct?
1
All carboxylic acids have similar chemical properties.
2
All alcohols have the same molecular mass.
3
Ethane and ethene are members of the same homologous series.
4
Ethane and propane are members of the same homologous series.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry
